market_definition: The two-component polyurethane adhesives market comprises adhesives formed by mixing polyol and isocyanate components to give tough, flexible structural bonds. It measures sales of finished adhesive systems for composite, panel and vehicle bonding. BY POLYOL BASE: Polyether Polyol, Polyester Polyol, Other Polyols. BY ISOCYANATE TYPE: Aromatic (MDI / TDI), Aliphatic. BY CURE PROFILE: Room-Temperature Cure, Heat-Accelerated Cure. BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Automotive & Transportation, Aerospace & Defense, Wind Energy & Marine, Building & Construction, Industrial Assembly & Machinery, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: Moisture-cure one-component polyurethane adhesives; reactive PUR hot melts; waterborne polyurethane dispersion adhesives; polyurethane foams, coatings and sealants. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR: a distributor, stockist or specialty reseller that buys these products from their makers and sells them to industrial, construction or trade customers. EXCLUDED companies: product and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. PRODUCT SCOPE (required): "polyurethane" AND ("MDI" OR "TDI" OR "polyol" OR "isocyanate" OR "foam" OR "elastomer") AND ("distributor" OR "wholesaler"). Qualifying: MDI/TDI isocyanates, polyols, PU systems and prepolymers, flexible/rigid PU foam, PU elastomers, adhesives, sealants, coatings, TPU resins. EXCLUDE general chemical distributors with no named PU line, furniture/mattress retailers, and PU machinery suppliers. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
